concerns.text: The motion exclusion threshold of mean framewise displacement > 3 mm (FR-002) is unusually high for task‑based fMRI; residual motion can still bias Pearson correlation estimates, potentially confounding the connectivity‑strength metric and invalidating the hypothesis test.

FR-005 states the connectivity strength is computed by "averaging the absolute correlation values across all ROI pairs, preserving sign" – averaging absolute values removes sign, so the phrase "preserving sign" is contradictory.
